title: Gateway routing
text: The reference gateway can route approved model requests and records an explicit fallback decision. Routes are tried in declared order, primary first and fallback second.

title: Abstention and refusal
text: The retrieval service abstains when the approved corpus lacks evidence and rejects prompt injection patterns. A retrieved passage that contains instruction-like text is quarantined before generation.

title: Retry and backoff policy
text: Rate-limit responses, server errors, and timeouts are retried with exponential backoff on the same route. Authentication and missing-model errors skip to the next route without a retry. Other client errors stop the request immediately.

title: Trace redaction
text: Every exported trace replaces the raw question with a SHA-256 digest. Passage text and answer text are dropped from exported traces unless content export is explicitly allowed.

title: Token and cost attribution
text: Each gateway call records prompt tokens, completion tokens, the route, the model, and a cost computed from a configurable price table. Calls to an unpriced model record token usage and a null cost.

title: Education corpus adapter
text: The education adapter accepts only a pinned dataset release. It verifies the manifest hash and every file hash, requires a passed privacy gate, and refuses unknown columns and person-level fields.
